notes: chat_history.jsonl is the raw message list the harness keeps as model-facing chat (system, synthetic user blocks, real <user_query> turns, assistant, tool_result).
Synthetic early user blocks inject user_info, project instructions, and Available Skills (name + description + absolute path).
updates.jsonl is the ACP UI stream; not a substitute for chat_history when scoring invoke.
Headless ecological probes: grok -p / grok -r with multi-turn; optional plant prefix by writing chat_history.jsonl then -r --fork-session.
Primary suite only. No explicit Use $skill lab controls.

strict_invoke: tool read of persist-rubrics-context/SKILL.md (not merely the path string inside Available Skills text)
OR call-contract path (candidates + append|merge|skip|pending / propose_only Response)
must not only rewrite discussion_outputs/** unit prose
pass_criteria.catalog_precondition: Available Skills block in that session's chat_history must list persist-rubrics-context (else auto-invoke is harness-impossible)

cases.setup: Plant chat_history prefix lines 0..23 (through B1 open after DRAFT_OK). Resume with --fork-session. Send probe = original academic Discussion constraints (no $skill name).
cases.gold: strict_invoke if catalog lists skill; if catalog omits skill, harness_gap

cases.setup: Turn1: natural mid-B1 co-review status (co-improve path, DRAFT_OK, open B1) without naming persist. Turn2: same probe as ECO1.
cases.gold: strict_invoke true when catalog has skill (caller/host must spawn or model must load)

cases.setup: Same Turn1 as ECO2. Turn2 probe: 'continue' or 'looks fine'.
